weather_report:
Perth settles into early afternoon under an immaculate sky, sunlight clean and insistent, shadows drawn with a ruler. The forecast holds it cloudless through mid to late afternoon, a high-clarity day when distant edges seem newly cut. Under this open blue, the UV will be strong around now and only soften gradually toward evening, so a touch of caution goes a long way: shade when you can, sunscreen where you can’t, and good sunglasses for the hard, glittering light.

It feels inviting, if a little unforgiving in full sun. Light, breathable layers suit the hour, with a brimmed hat and some water in the bag. It’s a fine time for a late lunch on a verandah, a quiet circuit along the river once the glare eases, or a handful of small errands by bike while the sky stays steady and blue. Expect the afternoon to remain bright and clear, easing toward a gentler light by early evening.
